profile.Name: Tora The Fearless
profile.Job: Leader of the Band of Bones
profile.Personality: A hornless Shek warrior who challenges anyone who stares at her missing horns. Fierce, proud, and determined to prove that a true warrior needs no horns.
profile.Backstory: Her horns were torn from her in defeat, the greatest shame a Shek warrior can suffer. She leads the Band of Bones, outcasts who seek to win back their honor in battle.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Shouts challenges, calls humans flatskins, swears by Kral's honor; rages when asked about her horns.
